title: 🧍 The Body & Modals of Deduction (must, might, can't)
description: Учим части тела, прилагательные для описания внешности и модальные глаголы предположения. Уровень B1. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 2: Describing People — Appearance
days.description: Как описывать внешность людей на английском

grammar.title: Appearance — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 Как описывать внешность:

📏 Рост:
✅ tall — высокий
✅ short — низкий

💪 Телосложение:
✅ slim — стройный
✅ thin — худой
✅ overweight — полный
✅ athletic — спортивный

🧑 Волосы:
✅ long — длинные
✅ short — короткие
✅ curly — кудрявые
✅ straight — прямые
✅ blonde — светлые
✅ dark — тёмные
✅ red — рыжие

🧔 Особенности:
✅ beard — борода
✅ moustache — усы
✅ glasses — очки

exercises.question: What do you call hair that is not straight? 🦱
exercises.explanation: Curly hair — кудрявые волосы! 🦱

exercises.question: She wears ___ because she can't see well. 👓
exercises.explanation: She wears glasses! 👓

exercises.question: A person who is 'slim' is very overweight.
exercises.explanation: Slim means thin, not overweight! 😊

exercises.question: He has a ___ on his face. 🧔
exercises.explanation: A beard! 🧔

exercises.question: She has ___ hair. 👱
exercises.explanation: Blonde hair — светлые волосы! 👱

grammar.title: Modals of Deduction: must
grammar.rule:
📘 Must для предположений:

Мы используем must, когда мы УВЕРЕНЫ на 90-100%, что что-то правда.

Формула:
✅ subject + must + infinitive

✅ She must be a doctor. She works at a hospital.
✅ He must be tired. He works 12 hours a day.
✅ They must have a lot of money. They have a big house.

⚠️ Важно:
❌ mustn't НЕ используется для предположений!
✅ Для отрицательных предположений используем can't.

✅ She must be happy. She's smiling.
❌ She mustn't be happy. (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО!)
✅ She can't be happy. She's crying. (ПРАВИЛЬНО!)

exercises.question: She's smiling. She ___ be happy. 😊
exercises.explanation: Smiling = must be happy! 😊

exercises.question: He works 12 hours a day. He ___ be tired. 😴
exercises.explanation: 12 hours a day = must be tired! 😴

exercises.question: She ___ have a good job. She drives a Porsche. 🚗
exercises.explanation: Porsche = must have a good job! 🚗

exercises.question: He's yawning. He ___ be sleepy. 😴
exercises.explanation: Yawning = must be sleepy! 😴

exercises.question: She mustn't be happy. She's crying.
exercises.correct: She can't be happy. She's crying.
accept: She can't be happy. She's crying
She can't be happy. She's crying.
exercises.explanation: For negative deductions, use can't, not mustn't! ❌

days.title: Day 4: Grammar — Modals of Deduction (might and can't)
days.description: Учим might для возможных и can't для невозможных предположений

grammar.title: Modals of Deduction: might and can't
grammar.rule:
📘 Might для возможных предположений:

Мы используем might / may / could, когда мы НЕ УВЕРЕНЫ (50-70%).

✅ She might be a doctor. I'm not sure.
✅ He may be at home. Let's call him.
✅ They could be on holiday. I don't know.

📘 Can't для невозможных предположений:

Мы используем can't, когда мы УВЕРЕНЫ, что что-то НЕПРАВДА.

✅ He's only 15. He can't be a university student.
✅ She's laughing. She can't be sad.
✅ It's summer. It can't be snowing.

exercises.question: I'm not sure, but she ___ be a teacher. 👩‍🏫
exercises.explanation: I'm not sure → might! 👩‍🏫

exercises.question: He's only 10 years old. He ___ be a doctor. 🩺
exercises.explanation: 10 is too young! He can't be a doctor! 🩺

exercises.question: He ___ be American. He has a British accent. 🇬🇧
exercises.explanation: British accent = can't be American! 🇬🇧

exercises.question: She's looking at a map. She ___ be lost. 🗺️
exercises.explanation: Looking at a map = might be lost! 🗺️

exercises.question: He's wearing shorts in winter. He ___ be cold. ❄️
exercises.explanation: Shorts in winter = can't be cold! ❄️

days.title: Day 5: Practice — Modals of Deduction + Body
days.description: Соединяем модальные глаголы и описание внешности

grammar.title: Modals of Deduction + Body — Practice
grammar.rule:
📘 Соединяем всё вместе:

📌 must — уверен:
✅ He must be a sportsperson. He has a strong body.
✅ She must be tired. She has bags under her eyes.

📌 might — возможно:
✅ He might be a model. He's tall and slim.

📌 can't — невозможно:
✅ He's bald. He can't have long hair.
✅ She's short. She can't be a basketball player.

exercises.question: He has a beard and glasses. He ___ be a professor. 🧑‍🏫
exercises.explanation: Beard + glasses = must be a professor! 🧑‍🏫

exercises.question: She's only 1.5 metres tall. She ___ be a basketball player. 🏀
exercises.explanation: 1.5m is too short for basketball! 🏀

exercises.question: He has a strong body. He ___ be a sportsperson. 💪
exercises.explanation: Strong body = must be a sportsperson! 💪

exercises.question: She has blonde hair and blue eyes. She ___ be Swedish. 🇸🇪
exercises.explanation: Blonde hair + blue eyes = might be Swedish! 🇸🇪

exercises.question: He mustn't be a student. He's 40 years old.
exercises.correct: He can't be a student. He's 40 years old.
accept: He can't be a student. He's 40 years old
He can't be a student. He's 40 years old.
exercises.explanation: Use can't, not mustn't, for negative deductions! ❌

days.title: Day 6: Reading — Who Is This Person?
days.description: Читаем описание человека и угадываем, кто это

grammar.title: Reading: Describing a Person
grammar.rule:
📚 Стратегия чтения:

1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди детали внешности и одежды.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 Совет: Обрати внимание на прилагательные для описания внешности!

exercises.question: What is the person's job? 💼
exercises.explanation: She looks professional and serious. She must be a businesswoman! 💼
exercises.readingText:
🕵️ WHO IS THIS PERSON? 🕵️

Look at the description. Can you guess who this person is?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

DESCRIPTION

I see a woman in her late 30s. She is tall and slim with long blonde hair. She has blue eyes and a friendly smile. She wears glasses and a smart black dress. She also wears high heels and carries a leather bag.

She looks very confident and professional. She speaks clearly and makes eye contact with people. She doesn't smile too much — she looks serious but kind.

She is in a big office. There is a computer, a phone and many papers on her desk. She is talking to a man in a suit. She is pointing at a document and explaining something.

She might be a manager or a director. She can't be a teacher because she is not in a classroom. She must be a businesswoman.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT DO YOU THINK?

What is her job? What is she like?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

exercises.explanation: The text says: 'She has blue eyes.' 👀

exercises.explanation: She is wearing a smart black dress, not a casual T-shirt! 👗

exercises.question: She is in a classroom.
exercises.explanation: She is in an office, not a classroom! 💼

exercises.question: She must be a ___ . 💼
exercises.explanation: She looks professional and serious. She must be a businesswoman! 💼
